description: Larkspur Goods is a compact timber shop packed with supplies. Bottles, jars, parcels and small boxes fill the tall shelves along the upper and right walls. A long counter with two stools divides the shop floor from the stock behind it. On the left, a stone fireplace burns beside stacked barrels and a chair, and a circular orange rug fills the open boards in the middle. Smaller tables hold glassware and tools near the lower edge, with bundles, sacks and crates tucked into the corners. Lanterns and the fire throw amber light across the wood, giving the stocked room a bright, close interior.
